notes.title: Level Editing Update 1
notes.content:
[p]The first Level Editing Update for FPDE is here!  This release introduces new ways to shape your world and set the mood:

🎨Customize the Sky - Pick your own sky color[/p][p]💡Dynamic Lighting - Adjust map lighting[/p][p]⭐️Prop Placement - Drop and move props anywhere[/p][p]🗒️Billboard Notes - Place custom notes

Hope you enjoy the new update![/p]

notes.title: Level Editing Update 1
notes.content: The first level editing update is here!  Adjust your sky's color, change lighting, and drop some props!

notes.title: 🌸 The Neural Garden 🌸
notes.content:
[p]🌸 The Neural Garden update is out! 🌸[/p][p][/p][p]This patch contains the Neural Garden. A new animated Explorer!

[/p][p]Conceived and shaped in collaboration with ChatGPT — from the initial spark and name, to the flowing movement, intricate shapes, and vibrant palette — [i]The Neural Garden[/i] is part data visualization, part interactive art.[/p][p][b]Included in this update:[/b][/p][list][*][p]🌿 [b]The Neural Garden Explorer[/b][/p][list][*][p]🎨 Choose your own colors and see BMU weights in vivid detail[/p][/*][*][p]🐝 Follow each data sample through every iteration[/p][/*][*][p]🔍 Zoom in and inspect the numbers driving each BMU[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Hope to see you in the garden to watch the flowers bloom! 🌺[/p]

notes.title: 🌸 The Neural Garden Update — Coming Saturday!
notes.content: [p][b]🌸 An Update is Blooming in First-Person Data Explorer — This Saturday, 8/9! 🌸[/b][/p][p]After two years of developing with ChatGPT, [i]The Neural Garden[/i] will be the first Explorer — and certainly not the last — primarily designed by ChatGPT.[/p][p]FPDE is delighted to announce [i]The Neural Garden[/i] — an animated Explorer that brings your data to life in a living, blooming landscape of neurons and petals.[/p][p]Conceived and shaped in collaboration with ChatGPT — from the initial spark and name, to the flowing movement, intricate shapes, and vibrant palette — [i]The Neural Garden[/i] is part data visualization, part interactive art.[/p][p][b]Release date:[/b] Saturday, August 9th[/p][p][b]Included in this update:[/b][/p][list][*][p]🌿 [b]The Neural Garden Explorer [/b][/p][list][*][p]🎨 Choose your own colors and see BMU weights in vivid detail[/p][/*][*][p]🐝 Follow each data sample through every iteration[/p][/*][*][p]🔍 Zoom in and inspect the numbers driving each BMU[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Hope to see you in the garden to watch the flowers bloom! 🌺[/p]
